note: Where to go if the business says no. Bodies marked real are real Australian organisations, checked on their official sites on verifiedOn. Harbour Bank is the household's fictional bank. A body is only offered for kinds of problem it can actually take: AFCA is left out because its rules generally exclude complaints about the level of a premium alone.

bodies.name: Telecommunications Industry Ombudsman
bodies.whenToUse: Free and independent. Use it if your provider hasn't fixed the problem after you've asked.

bodies.name: Energy and Water Ombudsman Victoria
bodies.whenToUse: Free and independent. Use it if your energy company hasn't fixed the bill after you've asked.

bodies.name: Harbour Bank card disputes
bodies.whenToUse: If a business won't return a duplicate card payment, your bank can look into disputing that charge.

bodies.name: Consumer Affairs Victoria
bodies.whenToUse: Use it if you've tried to sort the problem out with the business and couldn't.
